issue_context.title: Sonos integration not updating after a while
issue_context.body:
### The problem

Since a couple of updates the sonos integration stops updating the stops with updating the infromation in HA.
All controlls keep working, but the song that is played will not be refreshed. Also the player keeps indicating it's in stop or pause instead of playing music.

This happens both with spotify music, radio, ... Both while started from HA and from the sonos app itself. 
I'm using 2 sonos One and both have the issue at the same time.

I'm unable to find any information in the logs regarding the Sonos integration. If more specific information is needed. I will try to answer to the best of my ability.


### What is version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2021.5.1

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant OS

### Integration causing the issue

Sonos

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/sonos/

### Example YAML snippet

_No response_

### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?

_No response_

### Additional information

_No response_

Hey there @cgtobi, @jjlawren, mind taking a look at this issue as its been labeled with an integration (`sonos`) you are listed as a [codeowner](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/dev/CODEOWNERS#L456) for? Thanks!
<sub><sup>(message by CodeOwnersMention)</sup></sub>

Without any logs it's hard to tell what the cause may be. Please take a look at the log file at `<config>/home-assistant.log` and search for anything related to `homeassistant.components.sonos` or `pysonos`.

There's a fix coming in 2021.5.2 for network setups where push-based subscriptions aren't working properly (#50265). There was also an issue in the underlying library which was very recently fixed (https://github.com/amelchio/pysonos/pull/83) which I'll try to get into a point release. Both of those issues can unfortunately cause the `media_player` entities to stop updating.

@jjlawren: I checked the log file earlier and didn't find anything sonos related. Unfortunatly I was forced to restore a 3 day old snapshot earlier today, and am unable to check older logs. Normally the issue happens almost every day or maximum 2-3 days. So I will come back with more information when it happens again.

Thanks for the quick first response.

@jjlawren: I have been searching my logfiles a couple of days now. Even with 2021.5.3 the issue is still happening. 
But there is nothing to see in the logfiles. If I search for 'sonos' in the logs, I come back empty handed.

What I did notice is that they seem to stop working after my wifi went out for a couple of seconds/minutes. A lot of my wifi devices then come unavailable for a minute, but restore afterwards. 

Sonos stays in the last state he knows. When the wifi is back up, controlling sonos is possible but there is no feedback anymore from the device. No state, no new music listing,...

Hopefully you can do something with this.
Same here. I have search my logs but nothing to find. I have rebooted my Pi to just to be sure and until now it still working.

Thanks for searching. After looking a bit more I think we're not seeing any errors because the library is silently swallowing up exceptions in certain situations. I'm running a custom library version at the moment to see if this is the case. Hopefully I can reproduce this by forcing a network blip as you've described.
I've encountered this after a firmware update, but even with the custom library and extra logging there's no obvious indication why this is occurring. Will need to do some more research.

I am not sure if  it is related to any firmware update: I don't recall any update on my Play1 since a while.
All my 5 Sonos Play1 have Vers 13.1
I bumped into this problem since 2021.5.X but once a day I have the same problem.
Yesterday I realized the the my volume scripts didn't work since I restarted HA and today my morning alarm didn't work (no errors or warnings in the log)
Restarting make everything ok.

The problem seems to relate to the 2021.5.X update. Non of the state attributes are being updated. A reboot of HA fixes the problem for a short while (Minutes of a low number of hours). 

What information would be useful for debugging, and where to find?

> Problem solved for me by disabling the integration, reenabling the integration and restarting Home Assistant

I gave it a try also, it will be a weird fix if it works. But it's also a weird fault, not showing any data in the logs.

Recreating the integration will not permanently resolve this problem. It appears that subscriptions are failing but there's currently now way to be notified if this occurs. This is easily reproducible by power cycling a speaker, but perhaps flaky network connectivity can also be a factor here.

I'm testing a few theories, but nothing is ready to consider as a fix just yet.
@jjlawren thank you for the update and all the work you put in it.
Does `Attempted to attach subscriptions to player` or `when existing subscriptions exist` appear in the log?

After lots of testing and sniffing network traffic, finally tracked down a (the?) problem and submitted the two PRs above. They're related to subscription renewals silently failing in the library when using the new async event handler.
Once 2021.5.5 is released, I'd be curious how often this occurs in setups where it's been a problem.

> Once 2021.5.5 is released, I'd be curious how often this occurs in setups where it's been a problem.

I think pretty often but many people don't notice. I noticed when my music didn't stop but restarted with a start/stop button, which actions depending on the playing state.
I did not encounter this issue until a forced restart from a firmware upgrade. If you're seeing this regularly you may want to check out your network/wifi.
this has been happening less often to my system since upgrading to 2021.5.4. I'll upgrade to 2021.5.5 and report back if I encounter it again.

2021.5.5 is out which addresses the last known issue here. I'm hoping that everyone here already upgraded and the silence is a good sign. 😉

The new change It will validate each subscription every ~20 minutes and recreate if necessary. Before it would try to renew subscriptions once a day and didn't even know if that process failed.

It's a bit noisy in the logs when it does detect a dead subscription but that's already addressed in 2021.6.

I updated yesterday evening. Since then no issues.

Every time I checked it was updating.
Great! Any new messages in the logs?
@jjlawren: no info in logs yet. Maybe my internet stayed online for more then a day. Had go back to an older snapshot yesterday for testing something else.
